summary: All 13 frozen hypotheses were executed. H1, H2, H3, H5, H6, and H8 refuted the work: unknown model-family strings pass RULE-7; executable C1..C6 runtime arms are absent; specialized configurations can omit the cross-family gate; the sole digest mismatch has row status cutoff rather than VOID; 193 rows differ after removing only digest/provenance; and several 019f4eea consumers still lack explicit VOID labeling. H4 and H10 are inconclusive because live contrast records and a complete Claude Code cache distribution are absent. The blocking verdict is reject.
